title.zh: v2.1.14 追到「同一个页面渲染久了会变声」的根因：GS-1 的 WASM 内存预算
title.en: v2.1.14 Root Cause of "a Long-Lived Page Renders Differently": the GS-1 WASM Memory Budget

highlights.zh: **上一版只是绕开，这一版追到了根因。** 把同一曲风按轨道拆开量（先量一遍 → 渲染 60 个别的曲风 → 再量一遍）：bass 与 fx 两根轨道**逐位相同**（Δ 0.000 dB），而 GS-1 负责的 chords **+13.050 dB**、lead **−16.555 dB**；limiter 两次都是 worklet、真峰都钉在 −1.30 dBTP，把 makeup 拉到 −12 dB（限幅器完全不介入）依然漂 +1.849 dB——所以差异在**内容**，不在母带链。给 host 创建的 `catch` 加上原因打印后真相就一句话：`WebAssembly.instantiate(): Out of memory: Cannot allocate Wasm memory for new instance`。
highlights.en: **The previous release worked around it; this one found the cause.** Measuring one genre track by track (before, then after rendering 60 other genres) shows bass and fx **bit-identical** (Δ 0.000 dB) while the two GS-1-routed roles move: chords **+13.050 dB**, lead **−16.555 dB**. The limiter is the worklet both times and the peak stays pinned at −1.30 dBTP; with makeup at −12 dB (limiter disengaged) the drift is still +1.849 dB — so it is the *content*, not the master chain…

highlights.zh: **一个页面能建约 124 个 GS-1 host，之后怎么拆都拿不回来**（每个策略开全新浏览器实测）：keep / keep+gc / `dispose()` / dispose+gc / dispose+`close()` 全部在第 124–125 个失败——`OfflineAudioContext` 上**根本没有 `close()`**，`host.dispose()` 只断开节点。只有刷新页面能释放，这正解释了为什么它看起来是「页面级」的、以及为什么上一轮的 dispose 实验无效。
highlights.en: **A page builds ~124 GS-1 hosts and then never another one**, measured with a fresh browser per policy: keep, keep+gc, `dispose()`, dispose+gc and dispose+`close()` all fail at instance 124-125 — `OfflineAudioContext` has no `close()` at all, and `host.dispose()` only disconnects the node. Only reloading the page frees it, which is why the effect looked page-scoped and why last round's dispose experiment changed nothing.

highlights.zh: **修法一：stem 渲染不再为用不到的轨道建 host。** 调度第一行就丢掉非本轨的轨，但 host 循环过去对每个 GS-1 角色都建一个，于是「母带 + 8 stems」一次导出白建 14 个 host（共 18 个）。现在只建 4 个：同一页面可导出的次数从约 7 次变成约 31 次。4 条单测钉住，删掉那行跳过会让其中 3 条立刻红。
highlights.en: **Fix one: a stem render no longer builds hosts it cannot use.** The scheduling loop drops every track but its own on the first line, yet the host loop built one per GS-1 role anyway, so one "master + 8 stems" export built 14 hosts that could never sound (18 in total). It now builds 4: roughly 7 exports per page become roughly 31. Four unit cases pin it; deleting the skip fails three of them.
